summary: RG-3 Core producer package: implement the Core Plan ledger/projection foundation that Plugin's later alembic_plan MCP tool will consume. This package is Core-only and must preserve the requirement spine ProjectContext(source) -> Plan(authority) -> Recipe. Additive implementation only, no behavior regression.

targetTasks.summary: Current window: AlembicCore. Claim only task rg3-core-plan-ledger-projection-t1 under stateRoot .wakeflow-active/current/alembic-recipe-evolution-optimization-2026-06-21. Context: RG-1 and RG-2 are accepted; Core now has architectureIntelligence and dimensionPlanning signals. Goal: implement RG-3 Core Plan ledger/projection foundation as real deterministic Core code, additive and package-boundary clean, so Plugin can later expose alembic_plan draft/confirm/get without inventing state or double-writing generation status. Required behavior: (1) add a Core Plan domain/contracts surface for Plan intent and living-ledger reads: plan id/version/status, selected dimensions/order/priority/stage targets, scale/budget decisions, module or scope bindings, planned next actions, projectContextSignature, rationale/evidence refs, and change/confirmation metadata as needed by downstream Plugin; (2) add plans table persistence through the existing AlembicCore database/migration/repository patterns, storing intent only; no generation-state double write in the plans table; (3) add a read-time generation-state projection/merged Plan view from existing Core data sources such as knowledge_entries, recipe_source_refs, evolution_proposals, lifecycle_transition_events or the repositories/read models that already represent them; projection must compute coverage/status/change/proposal facts instead of storing those facts in Plan intent rows; (4) add Core service/helpers for draft information packages and confirmed Plan retrieval that reuse MissionBriefing/OnboardingContract/DimensionTask-style existing models where appropriate plus RG-1/RG-2 architecture/dimension planning outputs; this is a Core foundation, not the Plugin MCP tool or an agent prompt; (5) add projectContextSignature compute/compare support sufficient for later hard gates to detect stale confirmed plans, but do not wire bootstrap/rescan/deep-mining/module-mining gates in this task; (6) expose only the minimum Core surfaces needed for downstream Plugin consumption through existing allowed package exports/indexes, following AlembicCore AGENTS public API rules; (7) add fixture-backed tests for intent persistence, confirm/get lifecycle, generation-state projection from existing records, no-double-write behavior, projectContextSignature mismatch detection, and compatibility with existing ProjectContext/recipe/evolution data models. Boundaries: do not implement Plugin alembic_plan MCP tool, do not implement three-stage Recipe generation, create-time ProjectContext anchor, vector isolation/isAvailable, timing fixes, commit-driven unified evolution, Test/BiliDili scenario, daemon/watch behavior, or changes to existing four-tool MCP semantics. Do not create a type-only shell, static mock, or new plan abstraction disconnected from existing Core storage/read models. If the full RG-3 Core slice is too large for one target turn, return blocked/needs-review with the smallest executable split and raw evidence; otherwise complete with commit hash, changed files, evidence refs, validation output, risks, and next-step notes. Expected validation: npm run build:check; targeted tests for Plan intent persistence/projection/signature; migration/idempotency tests if schema changes; existing recipe/project-context/evolution tests touched by the change; public API/export/boundary tests if exports change; npm run lint or npm run check when feasible; npm run test when feasible; git diff --check.
